scope: Three independent HD pose originals: shy, bow, hug-tail. No src or current v5 runtime atlas changes.
pixelModifications: none; all accepted PNGs are byte-identical copies of built-in generated originals
measurementMethod: Read-only Pillow alpha-channel inspection at thresholds 1,16,128,250; half-open bounds [left,top,right,bottom]. Source PNG pixels were not modified. Low-alpha RGB previews were not treated as evidence of a matte.

visualReview.hands: Two distinct wrists and naturally overlapped hands; fingers remain continuous with reasonable occlusion. No clear extra, fused or forked digits identified.
visualReview.feet: Both shoe tips face forward and remain nearly parallel; knees and ankles align comfortably.
visualReview.clothing: Small chest bow, visible bodice, waist seam and existing hem/flowers preserved. Mild upper-body bow has closed eyes and relaxed stacked hands.
visualReview.framing: Complete character, native visible alpha>=16 height 1397px. Right visible margin is approximately 27px; no clipping.
visualReview.compositeReview: Root agent reported light/dark browser composition passed; central root evidence is authoritative.
